section_summary: This section chiefly documents applications, military clearances, extensions, and notifications concerning foreign business travel to occupied Japan, including applicants from Switzerland, South Africa, Burma, Hong Kong, Singapore, and the Philippines. It also contains a Far Eastern Commission policy decision and draft directive permitting limited foreign travel by screened Japanese commercial representatives. Additional records concern Dairen Germans, a proposed Brazilian tourist group, and routine file-control paperwork.

subfiles.title: Perret & Berthoud request for an entry visa for E. L. Bethell
subfiles.about: Requests permission for Edmond Laurence Bethell to visit Japan during a Far Eastern business trip.
subfiles.summary: Perret & Berthoud seeks forms or authorization for its British sales manager to spend two or three weeks in Japan.

subfiles.title: Authorization telegram for Edmond Laurence Bethell
subfiles.about: Authorizes Bethell to enter Japan and gives documentary instructions.
subfiles.summary: The Department reports military approval for Bethell to enter between November 1 and December 1 and remain sixty days.

subfiles.title: Referral of Bethell application to the Military Permit Section
subfiles.about: Explains the exceptional submission of Bethell's application for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards the firm's request after an erroneous procedural instruction and asks only for a memorandum if clearance is granted.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Bethell and Nader-Esphahani
subfiles.about: Records Japanese entry clearances for two commercial travelers.
subfiles.summary: The Army clears Bethell and Nader-Esphahani for specified entry periods and requests notification of the appropriate agencies.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Leofric Maxwell with annotations
subfiles.about: Records Maxwell's clearance to enter Okinawa for shipwrecking business.
subfiles.summary: Maxwell is cleared to enter Okinawa between October 8 and November 8 for Mollers Suidah Shipwreckers.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Leofric Maxwell
subfiles.about: Provides a clean copy of Maxwell's Okinawa entry clearance.
subfiles.summary: The Army records Maxwell's sixty-day Okinawa clearance and asks that the appropriate agency be notified.

subfiles.title: Authorization telegram for Leofric Maxwell
subfiles.about: Notifies Maxwell of his authorization to enter Okinawa.
subfiles.summary: The Department reports Maxwell's clearance and directs that a certified telegram copy substitute for the required statement.

subfiles.title: Blank file charge sheet
subfiles.about: Provides a blank form for charging State Department records to an office or individual.
subfiles.summary: Blank form for recording the temporary charge of a document or file.

subfiles.title: Prentiss-Lane registered-mail envelope
subfiles.to: Military Permit Office, Department of State
subfiles.about: Envelope used to send Prentiss-Lane's military-permit correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Registered envelope addressed to the State Department's Military Permit Office.

subfiles.title: Request to extend Raghbir Singh Narula's permit
subfiles.about: Requests a one-month extension of Narula's entry period because of unfinished American business.
subfiles.summary: Prentiss-Lane returns permit 10182 and asks that Narula's deadline for entering Japan be extended to November 17.

subfiles.title: Reply granting Narula a replacement military permit
subfiles.from: Walter P. Chappell for the Acting Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Sends a new permit extending Narula's Japanese entry period.
subfiles.summary: The Department notes that resubmission is normally required but encloses permit 12068, valid October 21 through November 21.

subfiles.title: Request for reissuance of Narula's military permit
subfiles.about: Returns Narula's permit to the Army for an agreed extension.
subfiles.summary: Following consultation with Major Larson, Chappell asks the Army to reissue Narula's permit with a November validity date.

subfiles.title: South African note transmitting Caudarella's application
subfiles.from: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim, Union of South Africa
subfiles.about: Transmits the government-sponsored Japanese entry application of Franco Alberto Caudarella.
subfiles.summary: The South African Legation forwards Caudarella's application and requests notice of the result.

subfiles.title: Business-visit application of Franco Alberto Caudarella
subfiles.about: Applies to visit Japan for textile representation and South African wool sales.
subfiles.summary: Caudarella proposes a two-month visit to several Japanese cities in February or March 1949.

subfiles.title: Referral of Caudarella application to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of Caudarella's trade application.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards the sponsored South African application and asks for notification of the Supreme Commander's decision.

subfiles.title: Later file charge-out record
subfiles.about: Records later circulation of several State Department decimal files.
subfiles.summary: A 1956 charge-out card lists several files and the offices or persons receiving them.

subfiles.title: Dairen telegram concerning Hilde and Gerd Wieba
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP clearance for a Brazilian woman and her young son.
subfiles.summary: The consulate reports a Brazilian Embassy request for Japanese entry clearance for Hilde Sudhaus Wieba and five-year-old Gerd.

subfiles.title: Relay of Tokyo telegram to Dairen
subfiles.about: Directs Dairen to receive and distribute the text of an October 19 Tokyo telegram.
subfiles.summary: The Department orders Tokyo's message inserted and relayed, with repetitions to the embassies or consulates at Nanking and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Commerce Department memorandum on approved Japan and Korea travelers
subfiles.about: Transmits a list of applicants approved by Commerce subject to military approval.
subfiles.summary: Commerce forwards approved Japan and Korea travel applicants and copies of alien applications handled by Protective Services.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Bethell and Nader-Esphahani
subfiles.about: Confirms the approved entry periods of Bethell and Nader-Esphahani.
subfiles.summary: The Army lists Bethell's October-November window and Nader-Esphahani's December-January window for sixty-day Japanese visits.

subfiles.title: Authorization telegram for Hassan Nader-Esphahani
subfiles.about: Reports permission for Nader-Esphahani to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Department authorizes entry from December 15 through January 15 for a sixty-day stay and cites documentation instructions.

subfiles.title: Certification of Far Eastern Commission policy document
subfiles.about: Certifies the attached policy as a correct copy of the unanimously adopted original.
subfiles.summary: Johnson certifies the commercial-travel policy adopted at the Commission's 124th meeting.

subfiles.title: Travel Outside Japan of Japanese Commercial Representatives
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.about: Sets conditions for limited foreign travel by Japanese commercial representatives.
subfiles.summary: The policy permits essential, destination-approved commercial travel while requiring equal treatment of foreign traders, screening by SCAP, nonpolitical activity, and Japanese governmental responsibility for travelers.

subfiles.title: Excerpt from draft minutes of the 124th Far Eastern Commission meeting
subfiles.about: Records debate and voting on Japanese commercial travel abroad.
subfiles.summary: Delegates define the extent of permitted travel, discuss propaganda safeguards, and record Philippine opposition to admitting Japanese nationals. The amended policy passes ten to one, with the Soviet representative abstaining.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of Far Eastern Commission commercial-travel policy
subfiles.about: Requests preparation and transmission of a directive implementing the newly adopted policy.
subfiles.summary: Johnson forwards the policy and related minutes, explains the Commission's authority, and asks for notice when the directive reaches Tokyo so the policy can be released.

subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Secretary, SANACC, on Japanese commercial travel
subfiles.about: Requests Joint Chiefs of Staff transmission of a draft commercial-travel directive to General MacArthur.
subfiles.summary: Saltzman forwards the directive and interpretive statements for SCAP, asks that State resolve questions before transmission, and notes that public release awaits acknowledgment from Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Draft directive regarding travel outside Japan of Japanese commercial representatives
subfiles.from: Departments of State, Army, Navy, and Air Force
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.about: Drafts implementing instructions for controlled Japanese commercial travel abroad.
subfiles.summary: The directive incorporates the Far Eastern Commission's safeguards, assigns screening and supervision to SCAP, and provides for declassification seventy-two hours after SCAP acknowledges receipt and concurs.

subfiles.title: São Paulo telegram correcting the Brasiltur signature
subfiles.about: Corrects the final word in a prior telegram's signature.
subfiles.summary: The sender asks that “BRASILTUR” replace “president” in the preceding telegram's signature.

subfiles.title: Telephone conversation concerning Narula's extended permit
subfiles.about: Records notification to Prentiss-Lane that Narula's extension was approved.
subfiles.summary: Mellor tells Burns that the Army approved a one-month extension; Burns requests mailing to the company and expresses gratitude.

subfiles.title: Burma Embassy note resubmitting applications of U Thein and U Hla Thwin
subfiles.from: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of Burma
subfiles.about: Requests State Department transmission of two Burmese business applications to SCAP.
subfiles.summary: Burma explains conflicting procedural advice, resubmits the applications, and encloses correspondence showing that they should proceed through Washington.

subfiles.title: British Embassy letter on Burmese businessman applications
subfiles.from: W. K. Smith, British Embassy, Rangoon
subfiles.about: Confirms that Burmese business applications must pass through the State Department.
subfiles.summary: Smith reports London's confirmation of the existing procedure and recommends returning the applications to Burma's embassy in Washington.

subfiles.title: Application of U Thein to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Seeks a short Japanese business visit to negotiate trade in Burmese produce and manufactured goods.
subfiles.summary: U Thein proposes travel through Bangkok and Hong Kong to Osaka and Tokyo for talks with Nichimen Jitsugyo.

subfiles.title: Application of U Hla Thwin to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Seeks permission to accompany U Thein as his business secretary.
subfiles.summary: U Hla Thwin requests a two-week visit to Osaka and Tokyo; the second page contains unused missionary questions.

subfiles.title: Copy of Burma Embassy note resubmitting two applications
subfiles.from: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of Burma
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; copy to Miss S. Mellor
subfiles.about: Provides a copied version of Burma's request concerning U Thein and U Hla Thwin.
subfiles.summary: The copy repeats Burma's procedural explanation and request for rapid SCAP consideration of both applications.

subfiles.title: Referral of U Thein and U Hla Thwin applications to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of two Burmese trade travelers.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards both applications following discussion with Major Larson and asks for a memorandum reporting the decision.

subfiles.title: Request to postpone Bethell's entry period
subfiles.about: Requests changing Bethell's authorized entry window to January-February 1949.
subfiles.summary: The firm explains that Bethell will arrive later than expected and asks that Geneva be cabled with revised dates.

subfiles.title: South African note transmitting Minter's application
subfiles.from: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim, Union of South Africa
subfiles.about: Transmits the sponsored Japanese entry application of Algernon Lionel Minter.
subfiles.summary: The South African Legation forwards Minter's application and asks to be informed of the result.

subfiles.title: Business-visit application of Algernon Lionel Minter
subfiles.about: Applies to contact former and prospective Japanese suppliers.
subfiles.summary: Minter proposes a two-to-three-week Tokyo visit for Raymond & Marshall Ltd., traveling by flying boat through the Middle East.

subfiles.title: Referral of Minter application to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of Minter's South African trade application.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards the sponsored application and asks the Army to report the Supreme Commander's decision.

subfiles.title: South African note transmitting Tancred's application
subfiles.from: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim, Union of South Africa
subfiles.about: Transmits the sponsored Japanese entry application of A. S. Tancred.
subfiles.summary: The South African Legation forwards Tancred's application and requests notification of the result.

subfiles.title: Business-visit application of Andries Stockenstrom Tancred
subfiles.about: Applies to arrange correspondent relationships between Volkskas and Tokyo banks.
subfiles.summary: Tancred seeks a six-week Tokyo visit, traveling by air from Johannesburg through the United States and Pacific islands.

subfiles.title: Referral of Tancred application to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of Tancred's South African banking trip.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards the government-sponsored application and asks for notice of the Supreme Commander's decision.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Caudarella
subfiles.about: Reports military clearance for Caudarella to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Caudarella is cleared to enter between February 15 and March 15, 1949, for a sixty-day stay.

subfiles.title: Notification of Caudarella's approved entry
subfiles.to: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim, Union of South Africa
subfiles.about: Notifies the Legation that Caudarella's Japanese entry was approved.
subfiles.summary: The Department gives the February-March entry window and explains the required passport endorsement, enclosing two commercial-entrant guides.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Ho Shun Ying
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese entry clearance for Ho Shun Ying of Albert Lee Company.
subfiles.summary: Ho Shun Ying is cleared to enter during November or December and remain sixty days.

subfiles.title: Telegram extending Ho Shun Ying's clearance
subfiles.about: Extends Ying's authorization so she may enter Japan during November.
subfiles.summary: The Department reports the military extension and states that documentation instructions remain unchanged.

subfiles.title: Army memorandum extending Bethell's entry period
subfiles.about: Approves revised January-February entry dates for Edmond Laurence Bethell.
subfiles.summary: The Army extends Bethell's entry window to January 1 through February 1, 1949.

subfiles.title: Telegram notifying Geneva of Bethell's revised dates
subfiles.about: Authorizes Bethell's postponed January-February Japanese entry.
subfiles.summary: The Department confirms that military authorities approved the requested change in Bethell's travel dates.

subfiles.title: Commerce approval memorandum for William A. Mustaki
subfiles.about: Reports Commerce approval of Mustaki's proposed business travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Commerce forwards Mustaki's application for final SCAP approval on behalf of Interchange of America, Incorporated.

subfiles.title: File note concerning Mrs. Seto's clearance record
subfiles.about: Explains why no background file accompanied the Seto telegram.
subfiles.summary: The note says Seto's facts arrived on a regular permit, which would be returned to the Army.

subfiles.title: Authorization telegram for Che Fan Seto
subfiles.about: Reports military permission for Che Fan Seto to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Seto is authorized to enter from October 29 through November 28 and use a certified telegram copy for documentation.

subfiles.title: Army memorandum concerning Walter and Mizzi Spitzer
subfiles.about: Reports SCAP's request for British verification of the Spitzers' sponsoring firm.
subfiles.summary: Theater headquarters has no knowledge of Max Rochmann Ltd. and asks for clearance through the British Board of Trade.

subfiles.title: Action slip requesting more information about the Spitzers
subfiles.about: Requests additional details before referring the Spitzers' application to the theater.
subfiles.summary: The Army seeks their purpose, former Japanese residence, and circumstances of departure for England.

subfiles.title: SCAP telegram denying immediate entry to Dairen Germans
subfiles.to: American Consul, Dairen; information to Department of State
subfiles.about: Declines current Japanese entry clearance for Germans stranded in Dairen.
subfiles.summary: SCAP cites unavailable support and transportation funds, notes Red Cross inquiries, and reports no immediate prospect of a repatriation vessel reaching Dairen.

subfiles.title: Singapore request to extend Josef Zuna's clearance
subfiles.about: Requests an extension because Zuna's entry permit arrived after expiration.
subfiles.summary: The consulate asks that Josef Zuna's Japanese entry clearance be extended through November 30.

subfiles.title: Telegram granting Zuna's extension
subfiles.about: Reports military approval of the requested extension for Josef Zuna.
subfiles.summary: The Department briefly confirms that military authorities granted Zuna's requested clearance extension.

subfiles.title: Manila telegram requesting clearance for Felipe Sanchez
subfiles.about: Requests Japanese entry authorization for Spanish shipping executive Felipe Sanchez.
subfiles.summary: Sanchez seeks a sixty-day Tokyo business visit for C. F. Sharp and Company, traveling from Manila by Northwest Airlines.

subfiles.title: Referral of Felipe Sanchez application to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of Sanchez's proposed business travel.
subfiles.summary: Chappell restates Sanchez's identity and itinerary and asks the Military Permit Section to report any theater clearance and its dates.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Josef Zuna
subfiles.about: Confirms Zuna's extended Japanese entry clearance.
subfiles.summary: Zuna of the Zlin Shoe Company is cleared to enter from November 1 through December 1.

subfiles.title: Return of expired Pincus Vnuk military permit
subfiles.about: Returns Vnuk's unused permit to the Army after its validity expired.
subfiles.summary: Chappell explains that the South African Legation will submit a new application if Vnuk later wishes to visit Japan.

subfiles.title: South African note returning Pincus Vnuk's expired permit
subfiles.from: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim, Union of South Africa
subfiles.about: Returns Vnuk's expired Japanese entry permit.
subfiles.summary: The Legation reports that Vnuk has not reached the United States and may apply again later.

subfiles.title: Memorandum for the files on the Brasiltur tourist proposal
subfiles.about: Records guidance given to Frank Loeb concerning a proposed Japanese-Brazilian tourist group.
subfiles.summary: Clark directs Brasiltur to consult Consul General Cecil Cross in São Paulo about clearing a large group of Japanese residents of Brazil for travel to Japan.

subfiles.title: Blank file charge sheet
subfiles.about: Provides a blank form for charging records to an office or division.
subfiles.summary: Blank records-control form for documenting temporary file charges.

subfiles.title: Return of Che Fan Seto's military permit
subfiles.about: Returns Seto's military permit after notifying Hong Kong of her theater clearance.
subfiles.summary: Chappell states that the American Consulate General at Hong Kong was informed by cable and encloses Seto's permit.

subfiles.title: Information copy of Seto authorization telegram
subfiles.about: Copies the notification granting Che Fan Seto permission to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: The telegram gives Seto's entry window, photographic requirement, and alternative documentation under SCAP Circular 8.

subfiles.title: Albert Lee Company application for Che Fan Seto
subfiles.from: Albert Lee Company and Mu Hsiang Chu
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Requests permission for Che Fan Seto to visit Japan on company business.
subfiles.summary: The application identifies Seto as the Hong Kong manager of a Massachusetts importer-exporter. She would visit Japanese firms and study business conditions in Yokohama, Kobe, Osaka, and Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Boston Regional Office memorandum forwarding Seto application
subfiles.about: Forwards four notarized copies of Seto's Japanese travel application.
subfiles.summary: The office explains that Seto will visit Japan while returning to Hong Kong after conducting Japan-related business in Boston.

subfiles.title: Albert Lee Company cover letter for Seto application
subfiles.from: Mu Hsiang Chu, Albert Lee Company
subfiles.about: Submits five application copies for Che Fan Seto's proposed Japanese visit.
subfiles.summary: Chu notes Seto's imminent voyage from Hong Kong to Boston and requests expedited Commerce Department assistance.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Algernon Lionel Minter
subfiles.about: Confirms Minter's Japanese entry clearance.
subfiles.summary: Minter is cleared to enter from November 10 through December 10 for Raymond & Marshall Ltd.

subfiles.title: Notification of Minter's approved entry
subfiles.to: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim, Union of South Africa
subfiles.about: Notifies the Legation that Minter has received Japanese entry clearance.
subfiles.summary: The Department gives Minter's November-December window and explains the passport statement required by SCAP Circular 3 and the commercial-entrant guide.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for U Thein and U Hla Thwin
subfiles.about: Reports military approval of the two Burmese businessmen's Japanese entry.
subfiles.summary: U Thein and U Hla Thwin are cleared to enter between November 9 and December 9 for Maung Thein Brothers.
